segment.name: Personal Lines
segment.systems: PAS A (mainframe COBOL/VSAM) · PAS B · Rate_Manual_HO.xlsx · ISO forms library (PDF) · UW rules engine · Filings_Log.xlsx
segment.operatingPattern: High-volume admitted personal lines split across a 1980s mainframe (homeowners/dwelling on PAS A) and a newer policy admin (auto on PAS B), with rate manuals and filing history living in spreadsheets beside the systems.
segment.distribution: Direct-to-consumer, captive agents, aggregators / comparative raters
segment.placement: Single admitted policy per risk, one state per policy
segment.reinsurance: Property cat XoL treaty plus coastal quota share; back-end only, invisible to the product model
segment.regulatory: State-by-state rate/rule/form filings — CA DOI prior approval (Prop 103), TX TDI and OH file & use, FL OIR; all tracked via SERFF and Filings_Log.xlsx

behavior.Product Taxonomy: Product codes live in the PAS A PRODMSTR VSAM master and the PAS B product table; state availability is implicit in which rate/rule set is loaded, not modeled explicitly.
behavior.Coverages: Coverage catalogs are COBOL copybooks (CVG-HO, CVG-DF) on PAS A and coverage-master tables on PAS B; endorsement coverages exist only as premium-bearing form attachments.
behavior.Terms: Limit/deductible ladders are hard-coded picklists in CICS screens and PAS B config; percentage relationships (Cov B/C/D off Cov A) are computed in rating code, not declared.
behavior.Rating: Rating is nine chained COBOL modules (RTG01–RTG09) on PAS A and a rating service on PAS B; the actuarial source of truth is Rate_Manual_HO.xlsx, re-keyed by IT each rate change.
behavior.Pricing: Fees, taxes and surcharges come from FEE-TBL / TAX-TBL lookups applied after rating; minimum premium and rounding rules are buried in RTG09.
behavior.Underwriting Rules: New-business eligibility and referral rules run in the UW rules engine for auto; homeowners rules are a mix of engine rules and CICS screen edits nobody has fully inventoried.
behavior.Forms: ISO editions live as PDFs in the forms library; attachment logic is the FRM-ATTACH table on PAS A and form-attach config on PAS B, keyed by coverage + state + effective date.
behavior.Filings: Every rate/rule/form change is filed through SERFF and logged manually in Filings_Log.xlsx; approved-version-to-system-version mapping is tribal knowledge.
behavior.Lifecycle Behavior: Quote/bind is CICS screens (PAS A) or portal/API (PAS B); issuance, renewal extract and cancellation are nightly batch jobs with per-state notice-day parameters.
